Plot cluster membership against a categorical predictor

Source: R/get_clustering_measures.R
plot_clustering_confusion.Rd

Plot cluster membership against a categorical predictor

Usage

plot_clustering_confusion(
  g,
  pred,
  cluster = ".louvain",
  normalise = c("none", "pred", "cluster"),
  n_levels = 20,
  base_size = 14
)

Arguments

g

igraph object with clustering

pred

character node attribute to cross-tabulate against.

cluster

clustering measure

normalise

one of "none" (raw counts), "pred" (proportion of each predictor level falling in each cluster) or "cluster" (composition of each cluster).

n_levels

maximum number of levels

base_size

size of text

Value

a ggplot object, or NULL (invisibly) if pred or cluster has more than n_levels levels.

Examples

plot_clustering_confusion(example_network_2, "Province")
#> Warning: Too many levels to plot (maximum 20): 'Province' has 3 levels and 'Louvain' has 87 levels.
